parents.name: Permeation
parents.description: Allows the user to phase their body through solid matter, including walls and the ground, by making their molecules spread apart.

parents.name: Hardening
parents.description: Hardens any part of the user's body to rock-like durability for offense and defense.

roll.strategyInstruction:
Fusion strategy — parent A is dominant and leads: Permeation's Emitter/Short logic is the main engine; Hardening only subtly modifies, limits, or reshapes how that engine expresses.
Coherence criteria (dominant-a):
- Preserve a recognizable operational essence from EACH parent; inherit what each power does, not merely its theme.
- Before prose, settle one concrete rule: permanent trait or activation/condition -> changed body, target, material, or resource -> practical consequence. Final wording need not follow this arrow format.
- Parent A supplies the main operation readers immediately recognize.
- Parent B changes exactly one trigger, medium, output, or limitation of that operation; it cannot be decorative flavor.
roll.antiMashupRule: Anti-mashup: one parent supplies the main loop; the other supplies one modifier, limit, or cost.
roll.antiMashupExample: Avoid this mashup for this strategy: ❌ "phase through walls while fully armored at all times"
roll.nameRegisterInstruction: Deadpan and plain: 1–3 everyday words, almost boring on purpose — like a nickname someone would actually say out loud.
roll.utilityNudge: Simplicity nudge for this variant: direct trigger - state activation in plain terms and avoid multi-step setup chains. Keep the description easy to summarize in one sentence.

typeDiscipline: Core model: the Quirk temporarily changes the user while active.
State what changes in the body and what returns to normal after use.
Clear wording models: "While active, the user converts their skin into adhesive mud." / "While active, the user turns their arms into flexible rubber."
Clear wording models illustrate sentence clarity only; do not copy their effect unless supported by the source quirks.
constraints.facetContract:
Facet contract (keep one central mechanism):
- Mobility: show movement, repositioning, or travel change. Clear wording models: "The user expels air from their soles to propel their body." / "The user becomes weightless while holding their breath."
Facet guidance: describe one core effect first. Once the mechanism is clear, do not append arbitrary targets, tracking restrictions, or inferred uses just to add detail. Extra facets stay light extensions of that same effect, not separate subsystems. Rolled facets describe how the hybrid presents; they never replace either parent's recognizable operational essence. Clear wording models illustrate sentence clarity only; do not copy their effect unless supported by the source quirks.
Source-faithfulness gate: only express a facet through behavior already supported by these parent descriptions. A tag does not authorize new healing, analgesia, calming, remote senses, stat boosts, or animal anatomy.
constraints.rangeProse: Range prose check: rolled range is Contact — touch or immediate grappling distance only. en.description must match this band; do not describe a different reach.
namingRules: Write en.name only after en.description — the title must give a clear idea of what the quirk does even if it is a pun, joke, or absurd-long register.
en.name uses a different voice than en.description — joke or cadence in the title, encyclopedic body text.
en.name must NOT read like a fantasy RPG skill, technical field label, or "[Parent theme adjective] + [Parent theme noun]" mashup.

Punctuation in en.name: commas and a single question mark are allowed when they sell the joke. At most one ? or one comma clause unless register is absurd-long. No exclamation marks, ellipses, or quotes in the title.
Funny names must still land as a joke, phrase twist, mental image, or spoken cadence — not random interjection + mechanic noun (e.g. avoid "Oops, Cushion" unless the full phrase is the joke).
Before finalizing en.name, ask: "Does this sound like a real anime Quirk title or a phrase someone could say?" If no, replace once in the SAME name register.

priorVariants.name: Phase Shell
priorVariants.description: The user can briefly turn their skin into a permeable shell that lets attacks pass through while keeping bones rigid.
